test_groupby_value_counts_dataframe_comp: test groupby value_counts produces same results as DataFrame.value_counts applied to each group
test_groupby_value_counts_dropna_combina: test groupby value_counts with different dropna settings on both groupby and value_counts
test_groupby_value_counts_mixed_grouping: test groupby value_counts with mixed grouping types including array, column, and lambda
